A '''Shrewsbury cake''' is a British [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]]. The cakes are often served multiple at a time.

== Ingredients ==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg white]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
*1 cup (1 stick) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], softened

== Equipment ==
*2 [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheets]]
*2 oven mitts
*[[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|Cooling rack]]
*[[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|Baking spray]]/a little extra butter
*[[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
*[[Cookbook:Spatula|Spatula]]
*Large mixing bowl
*Measuring spoons
*Plate

== Procedure ==
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F.
# Place butter in mixing bowl along with sugar. [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] until the mixture is fluffy.
# Break the egg into the mixture, and stir it in completely.
# Add the nutmeg and flour to the mixture, and stir in completely.
# Spray or butter the cookie sheets.
# Place teaspoons of the batter onto the cookie sheets about two inches apart. 
# Place in the oven and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 350°F for 10 minutes.
# Take the cakes out of the oven, if the cakes have stuck together, use a knife to cut them apart.
# Use spatula to place the cakes onto a plate.
# Enjoy.
